# Brain Health USA

> > Brain Health USA is a Los Angeles-based mental health practice offering comprehensive psychiatric, psychological, and telehealth services for children, adolescents, and adults across California.

Brain Health USA provides expert mental health care including psychiatry, psychology, medication management, and psychotherapy. The practice operates multiple California locations and offers HIPAA-compliant telehealth services, along with ACGME-accredited residency training and graduate clinical practicum programs.

## Core Services

- [Child Adolescent and Adult Psychiatry](https://brainhealthusa.com/services/child-adolescent-adult-psychiatry): Expert psychiatry services for children, adolescents, and adults across multiple CA locations.
- [Psychological Services](https://brainhealthusa.com/services/psychologist): Psychological services including CBT therapy and assessments for emotional healing.
- [Telehealth](https://brainhealthusa.com/telehealth): HIPAA-compliant telehealth and teletherapy services for convenient online mental health care.

## Mental Health Conditions

- [ADHD](https://brainhealthusa.com/adhd): ADHD diagnosis, treatment, and symptom recognition for children and adults.
- [Anxiety Disorders](https://brainhealthusa.com/anxiety-disorders): Anxiety disorders overview with diagnostic criteria, treatment, and prevalence statistics.
- [Depression](https://brainhealthusa.com/depression): Major Depressive Disorder overview with diagnostic criteria and treatment information.
- [PTSD](https://brainhealthusa.com/ptsd): PTSD overview, treatment information, and trauma recovery strategies and education.
- [Insomnia](https://brainhealthusa.com/insomnia): Insomnia and sleep disorders overview with treatment, therapy, and health statistics.
